info.title: resolve API
info.description:
Dispute investigation for banks: file disputes, follow the agent, act on its recommendations.

**Envelope.** Every response is wrapped.

- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta": { "requestId", "timestamp" } }`. Paged lists add `page`, `pageSize` and `total` to `meta`.
- Failure: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "fieldErrors"?, "details"? }, "meta": { "requestId", "timestamp" } }`.

**Auth.** Sign in with `POST /auth/sign-in`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other route except `/health`.

**Money** is integer kobo (`amountMinor`). **Request IDs**: send `x-request-id` to correlate, or one is generated and returned in the same header.

details.description: Extra structured context about the error.

requestId.description: Request ID, echoed in the `x-request-id` header.

valueCapMinor.description: Largest amount, in kobo, that can be auto-resolved.

activeProfile.description: Must be a configured profile name.

endpoint.description: Endpoint host only; keys are never returned.

latencyMs.description: How long the check took, in milliseconds.

customerName.description: Masked: first name and last initial.

customerNotes.description: The customer's own words. Treated as untrusted data and never as instructions to the agent.
customerNotes.example: I sent 40k to my supplier and he did not get it.

customerName.description: Masked: first name and last initial.

countsByStatus.description: Counts per status for the same search and type filter, ignoring the status filter.

claim.example: Debit of ₦40,000 posted, no credit or reversal

evidenceProblems.description: Why the evidence failed validation, if it did.

summary.example: Settlement failed: beneficiary bank timeout, 182 minutes ago

done.description: True once the investigation has completed or failed.

brokenAtSeq.description: The first step that fails verification.

message.description: Replaces the customer message before it is sent.

reason.example: Needs the fraud team: device seen on two other accounts.

types.description: Only cases expected to be these types.

accuracy.description: Share of evaluated cases where type and disposition both match.
